description: A stereo filter built from three multimode filters on each side, tuned apart from one another by a spread control, with low pass, band pass and high pass outputs

params.text: Sets the centre frequency of all six filters, held between 1Hz and 8000Hz
Sets the level going into both sides of the filter
Attenuates and inverts the FM 1 input
Sets the Q of all six filters, from 1 to 10
Attenuates and inverts the resonance CV
Spreads the three left filters apart, one of them falling and one rising away from the centre frequency
Spreads the three right filters apart, one of them falling and one rising away from the centre frequency
Attenuates and inverts the left spread CV
Attenuates and inverts the right spread CV

inputs.text: The left signal into the filters, scaled by the VCA knob
The right signal into the filters, scaled by the VCA knob
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the level into the filters is set by the VCA knob alone
Moves the spread of the left filters, attenuated by the MOD SL knob
Moves the spread of the right filters, attenuated by the MOD SR knob
A rising edge jumps the left spread up by five octaves, falling back over about half a second
A rising edge jumps the right spread up by five octaves, falling back over about half a second
Moves the centre frequency by the octave, attenuated by the FREQ MOD knob
Multiplies the depth of the FM 1 modulation by the voltage here
Moves the Q of all six filters, attenuated by the RES MOD knob

outputs.text: The low pass output of the left side, the three left filters summed
The low pass output of the right side, the three right filters summed
The high pass output of the left side, the three left filters summed
The high pass output of the right side, the three right filters summed
The band pass output of the left side, the three left filters summed
The band pass output of the right side, the three right filters summed

notes: the VCA knob starts at zero and it is the only way into the filters, so all six outputs stay silent until it is raised

inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.6: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
